judge.rationale: The candidate is an incomplete work-in-progress that stopped after implementing schema compilation in `ToolRegistry.register`. `ToolRegistry.execute` was never modified to actually run the compiled validator, so three of the four acceptance tests added by the candidate itself (`registry.acceptance.test.ts`) will fail when run. It also misses dynamic schema resolution/caching via `WeakMap`, most of the required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the doc comment on `execute`, and all required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`). Additionally, it leaves behind `.lore/dod.md` and `registry.acceptance.test.ts` artifacts that are not part of the repository's structure.
